related_questions.question: When to go to the ER for heart palpitations?

text_blocks.snippet: Seek emergency care for heart palpitations if they are accompanied by chest pain, shortness of breath, dizziness, fainting, or loss of consciousness. Also, go to the ER if you've never experienced palpitations before, if they're accompanied by other concerning symptoms, or if they don't stop on their own.
snippet_highlighted_words: if they are accompanied by chest pain, shortness of breath, dizziness, fainting, or loss of consciousness

list.title: Chest pain:
list.snippet: If you experience chest pain or discomfort along with palpitations, especially if it radiates to your arm, neck, jaw, back, or stomach, seek immediate medical attention, as it could indicate a heart attack.

list.title: Shortness of breath:
list.snippet: Difficulty breathing or feeling breathless alongside palpitations warrants emergency care.

list.title: Dizziness or fainting:
list.snippet: If you feel dizzy, lightheaded, or faint, or if you lose consciousness, seek immediate help.

list.title: Other concerning symptoms:
list.snippet: If you have unusual sweating, confusion, severe headache, or sudden weakness, go to the ER.

list.title: Palpitations with a known heart condition:
list.snippet: If you have a history of heart problems, including heart failure, and experience palpitations, it's crucial to seek immediate medical attention.

list.title: New or worsening palpitations:
list.snippet: If you've never had palpitations before or if they are new or more frequent, consult with a doctor.

list.title: Palpitations that don't stop:
list.snippet: If your palpitations don't resolve on their own and are accompanied by any of the above symptoms, go to the ER.

list.title: Unexplained palpitations:
list.snippet: If you can't identify a clear cause for your palpitations and they persist, seek medical advice.

list.title: Occasional palpitations:
list.snippet: If you experience occasional palpitations that are not accompanied by other symptoms, you can discuss them with your doctor at your next appointment.

list.title: Palpitations with a known cause:
list.snippet: If your palpitations are related to stress, caffeine, or other known triggers, and you can manage them effectively, you can discuss them with your doctor at your next appointment.
